mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_snapshot (user_id, total_asset, total_saving, total_spending, snapshot_date) SELECT u.user_id, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ca.status = 'ACTIVE' AND cc.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN ca.current_balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_asset, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ca.status = 'ACTIVE' AND cc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ca.account_type = 'INSTALLMENT_SAVINGS' THEN ca.current_balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_saving, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(th.amount) FROM transaction_history th INNER JOIN connected_account spending_account ON spending_account.account_id = th.account_id INNER JOIN codef_connection spending_connection ON spending_connection.connection_id = spending_account.connection_id WHERE spending_connection.user_id = u.user_id AND spending_connection.status = 'ACTIVE' AND spending_account.status = 'ACTIVE' AND th.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAW' AND (th.category IS NULL OR th.category != 'ASSET') AND th.transaction_datetime >= #{snapshotDate} AND th.transaction_datetime < DATE_ADD(#{snapshotDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ), 0) AS total_spending, #{snapshotDate} FROM users u LEFT JOIN codef_connection cc ON cc.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN connected_account ca ON ca.connection_id = cc.connection_id WHERE u.is_withdrawn = FALSE GROUP BY u.user_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_asset = VALUES(total_asset), total_saving = VALUES(total_saving), total_spending = VALUES(total_spending)
